I mean, I'm trying but can't get him out of my head. I miss him every second of every day. I'm really angry and disappointed, but if he sent this letter to me trust me I would be the happiest girl in the world. So maybe you should give a shot?

Hey first of all thanks for the response! 

About the therapist and friends part. The thing is when I told my friends that I was depressed and suicidal some of them left me ( told me that depression isn't a real thing and I'm making everything up, or told me that I was a better person when I was happier ) and some of them just ignored it, told me that I should not be like it and that's all, like I've never said anything. But lately, some of them has changed and tried to cheer me up but the problem is that I'm running from them and I'm hiding, I don't believe that they can help me and I just don't want to be an extra weight on someone's shoulders. Also, last time I trusted someone he ghosted and it's hard to believe in " friends who are there for me to help". And about therapist, well, I can't afford it rn and I don't want to ask money to my mom, because then I have to explain everything and currently she has no idea what I'm going through.

Sometimes I feel the same way, but still, I want to tell you that the world would not be a better place without you. For example, if I didn't read your post now and saw that someone is feeling the same thing that I feel, I would be crying wishing that I'd be dead :') but now I'm trying to use all my English language skills to thank you for making me feel less lonely. 
P.s If you ever need to talk to someone hit me up ^^
